Headline results of the agent run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report via `python3 ~/poro/agent/report.py <run>`; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

Scope / data volume
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (3.314% of the time window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc).
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED probabilities (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5, LBNL catalogue — this is the calibrated estimate):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449,  P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.0001198,  P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 5.236e-06,  P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319,  P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.004922,   P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0002155,  P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281,  P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.01474,    P(Mw >= 5.5) over the observed volume = 0.0006484,  P(M >= 3)/yr = 0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection is counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts — this is the upper bound, not a calibrated estimate):
- b = 0.9849: Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw >= 5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Interpretation: the calibrated LBNL-catalogue estimate puts the annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw >= 5.5 event at roughly 1.2e-4 (b=1.0) up to ~1.5e-2 (b=0.65) per year, while the DAS-only upper bound, using uncalibrated magnitudes and over-counting detections, is 0.07842 per year. The DAS number should be read strictly as an upper bound; the catalogue-based numbers are the calibrated ones.
